sensors.name: PV Power
sensors.note: Ppv Low Word (IR2). Single MPPT — U_WORD sufficient. Scan 2026-03-12: 540W at noon.

sensors.name: AC Power
sensors.note: Pac. Confirmed working in ESPHome. Scan 2026-03-12: 534W at noon.

sensors.name: AC Frequency
sensors.note: Fac. Scan 2026-03-12: raw=5000 → 50.00Hz ✅. Was WRONG at IR38 (=Vac fault threshold 24Hz).

sensors.name: AC Voltage
sensors.note: Vac1. Scan 2026-03-12: raw=2404 → 240.4V ✅. Was WRONG at IR35 (=0).

sensors.name: AC Current
sensors.note: Iac1 (MIC600 Modbus v3.14 §4.2 Input Reg 15, unit 0.1A). Scale 0.1 + accuracy_decimals 1 so sub-amp currents (e.g. raw=3 → 0.3A) render as 0.3 A, not 0 A. Scan 2026-03-12: raw=21 → 2.1A (540W/240V≈2.25A ✅). NEW sensor.

sensors.name: DC Bus Voltage
sensors.note: P-Bus internal DC voltage. Scan 2026-03-12: raw=4805 → 480.5V (plausibel für DC-Zwischenkreis). Protocol v3.14 IR41=IPM Temp but V0.50 maps this differently.

sensors.name: Energy Total
sensors.note: U_WORD (not DWORD). Scan 2026-03-12: raw=2757 → 275.7kWh (ESPHome showed 272kWh prev day ✅).

sensors.name: Inverter Temperature
sensors.note: Confirmed: 21°C cold start, 37.8°C at noon. Protocol v3.14 maps IR93 as fault record but V0.50 uses it for temperature.

sensors.name: Modbus Version
sensors.note: Modbus protocol version. This device: 50 = V0.50 (early firmware, pre-V2.08 address shift). Affects register layout for AC output (at IR36-39, not IR11-15).

numbers.name: Modbus Unlock
numbers.note: Must write 1 before any holding register write

numbers.name: Active Power Rate
numbers.note: APR curtailment 0-100%. HR3 (FC03) — different space from IR3 (FC04, PV1 Voltage).

switches.name: Save Modbus Write
switches.note: Momentary write to persist current holding register settings to inverter EEPROM

notes.modbus_version: This device runs Modbus V0.50 (HR73=50), which predates the Growatt V2.08 register address shift (2012-04-28). AC output registers are at IR36-39, NOT at IR11-15 as in v3.14 protocol spec.
notes.ac_register_fix_2026-03-12: Physical RS485 scan confirmed: IR37=Fac(50Hz), IR38=Vac(240V), IR39=Iac. Previous mapping (ac_freq@IR38, ac_volt@IR35) was wrong.
notes.grid_registers_ir13_15: IR13-15 (Fac/Vac1/Iac1 per v3.14) return 0 on this V0.50 device — not implemented in this firmware generation.
notes.scale_factor: Most registers: scale 0.1. AC Frequency: 0.01. Inverter Status: 1.
notes.address_3_dual_use: Address 3 in input space (IR3, FC04) = PV1 Voltage. Address 3 in holding space (HR3, FC03) = Active Power Rate. Standard Modbus, no conflict.
notes.save_register_1044: HR1044: momentary write (value=1) persists all holding registers to EEPROM. Trigger after APR changes.
notes.pv_power_address: pv_power uses IR2 (U_WORD, single MPPT). Previous mapping used IR1 as DWORD high word which would be 0. IR2 confirmed: raw=5400 → 540W at noon.
